title: High-speed EMU within every limit
why: 300 km/h: the 250 km/h pass-by applies, and the cab row for 250 to 350 km/h.

noise.pass_by_250_db.rationale: Noise TSI 4.2.3 Table 4 (80 km/h: electric locomotives 84, diesel 85, EMUs 80, DMUs 81, coaches 79, wagons 83 dB; 250 km/h, if applicable: electric locomotives 99, EMUs 95, DMUs 96 dB): the design speed is 300 km/h, so the 250 km/h limit applies; EMU 95 ≤ 95.

noise.cab_standstill_horn_db.rationale: Noise TSI 4.2.4 Table 5 (cab, for units fitted with a cab: standstill with horns 95 dB; at vmax 78 dB if vmax < 250 km/h, 80 dB if 250 ≤ vmax < 350 km/h): 95 ≤ 95.

noise.cab_max_speed_db.rationale: Noise TSI 4.2.4 Table 5 (cab, for units fitted with a cab: standstill with horns 95 dB; at vmax 78 dB if vmax < 250 km/h, 80 dB if 250 ≤ vmax < 350 km/h): 250 ≤ 300 < 350, so 80 dB; 80 ≤ 80.
